title: HTTP Basics and Requests Library - Quiz

questions.question: What is the purpose of an HTTP status code?
options: To encrypt the data being sent
To tell the client the outcome of their request
To specify which HTTP method to use
To determine the server's IP address
questions.explanation: Status codes are three-digit numbers sent by the server that indicate whether a request was successful (2xx), caused a client error (4xx), or resulted in a server error (5xx).

questions.question: Which HTTP method is used to retrieve data from a server?
questions.explanation: GET is used to request data from a specified resource. It should only retrieve data and have no other side effects.

questions.question: What does a status code in the 400 range (e.g., 404) indicate?
options: Client Error - There was a problem with the request
Server Error - The server failed to process the request
questions.explanation: 400-range codes indicate client errors. 404 specifically means 'Not Found' - the requested resource doesn't exist on the server.
